purpose: Names the frozen US-short governance presets whose contents define the selection and action rules in force. The weekly diagnostic record fingerprints exactly this list so a 26-week report can segment by rule version. Design section 6: the fingerprint is factual metadata, never an input to adjudication, and a rule upgrade segments the report rather than resetting the 26-week clock.
why_a_declared_list: A fingerprint over 'whatever the engine happened to import' is not reviewable and drifts silently. A fingerprint over the weekly decision artifact would change every week and make mixed_ruleset_window permanently true, which destroys the thing section 6 wants it for. So the list is declared here, in a file whose own change is visible in a diff.
